For a transport company in Rekkem, we are looking for several CE drivers. Profiles wanted:
 
 
 
• CE drivers 
 
• Mooffett (truck-mounted forklift) drivers 
 

 Possibility of 2 to 3 overnight stays per week (UK). Also opportunities for drivers who prefer to be home more frequently or daily.

Who are we looking for?
 
 
 
• Living within approximately 20 minutes of our site at LAR in Rekkem

This Receptionist role is a front-of-house position focused on delivering a professional experience to visitors while ensuring the smooth day-to-day coordination of office operations, meeting facilities and administrative support. The successful candidate will manage reception activities, room bookings, travel arrangements, courier services and general office support within an international business environment.

 

Client Details

Our client is a prestigious international law firm based in Brussels. To support its operations during a temporary period, they are currently looking for a Receptionist to join their team until the end of December.

 

Description

As a Receptionist, you will be the first point of contact for visitors and play a key role in ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the office. Your responsibilities will include:

• Managing the switchboard, forwarding calls, screening incoming calls and taking messages.
• Welcoming visitors and ensuring a professional reception experience.
• Supporting visitors with administrative requests such as printing, copying and other practical needs.
• Managing visitor badges and access procedures.
• Coordinating meeting room bookings and updating reservations as required.
• Ordering catering services and assisting with meeting room set-up when needed.
• Monitoring conference rooms and liaising with internal teams to ensure facilities are maintained.
• Arranging travel, hotel, restaurant and transportation bookings.
• Organising courier services and outgoing mail.
• Coordinating flower orders and other office-related requests.
• Acting as a point of contact with IT and other support functions when required.

 

• Previous experience in a Receptionist, Front Office or Administrative Support role.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Professional, positive and service-oriented attitude.
• Fluent English; knowledge of French and/or Dutch is a strong asset.
• Good command of MS Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint).
• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
• Ability to remain calm under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
• Proactive, flexible and reliable approach to work.
• Team player with excellent relationship-building skills.

Our client is a leading international retail organization operating across multiple countries. This company is investing heavily in the modernization and optimization of its technology landscape, with SAP playing a central role in supporting business operations and future growth.

As part of its ongoing digital transformation journey, the organization is strengthening its SAP Retail team to enhance business processes, improve operational efficiency, and support strategic initiatives across procurement, supply chain, inventory management, pricing, and store operations.

As Senior SAP Retail Specialist, you will join a team of experienced professionals working closely with stakeholders across business and IT functions to deliver impactful solutions that support the organization's long-term ambitions.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior SAP Retail Specialist, you will be responsible for supporting, optimizing, and evolving SAP Retail solutions across the end-to-end retail value chain.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Supporting and enhancing SAP Retail business processes across procurement, inventory management, assortment management, pricing, replenishment, logistics, and store operations.
• Gathering business requirements and translating them into functional specifications and effective SAP solutions.
• Configuring SAP Retail functionalities and ensuring alignment with SAP best practices.
• Driving process standardization and continuous improvement initiatives across business units and countries.
• Providing 2nd and 3rd line functional support, investigating incidents, identifying root causes, and coordinating issue resolution.
• Contributing to SAP transformation and S/4HANA-related projects by participating in workshops, solution design activities, testing, and deployment initiatives.
• Collaborating with business users, project teams, implementation partners, and external service providers.
• Supporting system integrations with eCommerce platforms, warehouse management solutions, financial applications, POS systems, EDI interfaces, and other third-party solutions.
• Assisting data migration activities and promoting data quality and governance best practices.
• Acting as a trusted advisor for business stakeholders while mentoring junior team members and facilitating knowledge transfer.
• Ensuring the stability, performance, and long-term sustainability of SAP Retail solutions

To succeed in this role, you will combine strong SAP Retail expertise with excellent stakeholder management and problem-solving capabilities.

You ideally bring:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field.
• At least 8 years of SAP experience, including a minimum of 5 years focused on SAP Retail.
• Proven experience working within large-scale retail organizations and complex international environments.
• Strong expertise in:
• SAP Retail
• SAP MM
• SAP SD
• Assortment Management
• Article Master Data
• Purchasing Processes
• Inventory Management
• Invoice Verification
• Retail Pricing
• Exposure to SAP S/4HANA Retail, SAP CAR, SAP Datasphere, SAP BTP, or SAP Integration Suite would be considered a strong advantage.
• Solid understanding of retail and supply chain business processes.
• Experience in solution design, requirements gathering, testing, and change management.
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
• Excellent communication and relationship-building abilities.
• The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
• Fluency in English and either French or Dutch.

Our client is an international organisation headquartered in Brussels, bringing together members and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a fast-paced and multicultural environment, the organisation is seeking an Administration Officer to support its administrative, financial and office management activities and help ensure the efficient running of its operations.

Jobomschrijving

As a Project Officer your responsibilities are:

• Manage shared mailboxes and handle day-to-day business correspondence.
• Process invoices and maintain accurate supplier and financial records.
• Support payment processing, budget tracking and expense administration.
• Coordinate with external finance partners and maintain relevant documentation.
• Oversee recurring fees, contributions and other incoming payments.
• Track contracts, renewals, deadlines and purchasing activities.
• Prepare administrative and financial reports, dashboards and internal tracking files.
• Ensure project documentation, agreements and supporting records are complete and up to date.
• Assist with the preparation of documentation for audits, compliance reviews and regulatory requirements.
• Coordinate office facilities, suppliers, equipment and service providers.
• Support employee onboarding and offboarding administration.
• Maintain efficient filing systems and contribute to process improvements.
• Provide broader administrative and operational support as needed.

A successful Project Officer should have:

• Previous experience in administration, operations support, office coordination or a similar role.
• Strong organisational skills with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
• Confident user of Microsoft Office applications, including Excel.
• Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
• Able to prioritise workloads, manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
• Proactive, reliable and solution-oriented approach to work.
• Comfortable working independently while collaborating with a range of internal and external stakeholders.

CONCRETE WORKER – BORNEM – FULLTIME DAILY HOURS
At Manpower, we are looking for a Concrete Worker for a hands-on production environment where you see real results every day. As a Concrete Worker, you work in a fixed team where colleagues know each other and help out. The workplace is a concrete workshop with clear workstations and practical equipment. What makes this Concrete Worker job different? You receive on-the-job training so you can gradually take on more responsibilities.

Jobomschrijving

What does a working day look like as a Concrete Worker? You start at 6 a.m. and finish at 2:30 p.m., together with your team. As a Concrete Worker, your tasks are varied and concrete:

• You help produce precast concrete elements.
• You burn off cables following clear instructions.
• You occasionally operate the overhead crane.
• You carry out pressure tests to check quality.
• You support colleagues where needed and keep your workplace tidy.
As a Concrete Worker, you work closely with fellow workers and a team supervisor. Teamwork is key, and you can always rely on guidance on the floor.

What do we expect from you as a Concrete Worker?

Must-haves

• You can work in a fixed schedule from 6:00 to 14:30.
• You have a good knowledge of English or Dutch to follow instructions.
• You are willing to step in where needed and learn different tasks.
• You can work both independently and in a team.
• You work safely and in an orderly way.
Nice-to-haves

• Experience with concrete or an overhead crane is a plus for a Concrete Worker, but not required.

A highly reliable partner for our customers around the world, we offer environmentally friendly products that increase the comfort of homes and buildings in terms of insulation, safety, acoustics and air quality.

Remuneration: 17.5605 / h + shiftnumération : 2 shifts: 1.2497 /h + 4.5 euro meal vouchers per day worked.

As an operator in the recycling department, you and your colleagues will be responsible for the following tasks:

- supply and removal of materials by forklift truck

- filling the goods

- cleaning the production lines

 

You have had technical training or already have experience working within production.

You can work on a regular 2 shifts: 6h-14h, 14h-22h or fix night shift 22h-6h

You communicate in English

You can work with a PC.

You can work with a forklift truck. A certificate can be obtained through us.

Safe and clean work is important to you

You will be the analytical engine behind our clients' most challenging impurity investigations. You will design and execute highly sensitive mass spectrometry methods to ensure the safety and compliance of pharmaceutical products.
 
 

• Design, develop and validate sensitive and robust analytical methods for trace-level analysis quantification (with a primary focus on nitrosamine and NDSRI’s) using LC-MS/MS and HRMS, in compliance with ICH, FDA, and EMA guidelines.  

• Perform complex sample preparation and analysis in diverse pharmaceutical matrices, applying expertise in mass spectrometry (Triple Quadrupole, HRMS), chromatographic separation (UHPLC) and sample preparation.  

• Design robust extraction and sample clean-up strategies (e.g., SPE, liquid-liquid extraction) to overcome severe matrix effects in complex drug products, while strictly preventing artifact generation during analysis. 

• Conduct and support root cause investigations related to impurity formation, focusing on chemical pathways, impurity profiling, and risk assessment across drug substance and drug product development.  

• Deliver data and reports according to high scientific and quality standards. Contribute to method transfer and GMP documentation.  

• Promote innovation by exploring novel analytical approaches and emerging technologies to enhance detection limits and method robustness.  

• Support lab operations in full compliance with GMP and data integrity standards.  

• Interact with our clients to discuss scientific aspects.
  

• Represent Anabiotec/anacura in internal and external scientific forums and scientific conferences. 
 

• PhD in Analytical Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry (or a closely) related scientific field) or Master degree with at least 6 years of relevant industry experience.  

• Minimum of 4–6 years of hands-on experience in pharmaceutical R&D or analytical services.  

• Proven experience in LC-MS trace analysis in drug substances, drug products, or excipients is a strong asset.  

• Extensive practical knowledge of mass spectrometry (QqQ and orbitrap) and chromatography.  

• Experience in method development, validation, and transfer under GMP conditions.  

• Familiarity with regulatory requirements (ICH Q2, Q3, FDA/EMA guidance on nitrosamines) and GMP principles.  

• Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken) is required for high-quality scientific reporting. 

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a dynamic laboratory environment to project timelines.  

• Capable of prioritizing tasks across multiple urgent client projects in a dynamic CRO environment.

We are looking for a sorter of medical samples for a company active in the pharmaceutical sector. The company is located in Zaventem. As a sample sorter you are responsible for organizing, tracking, and distributing samples used in research, testing, or clinical trials.

Your tasks:

 

 
• You collect samples from storage and prepare them for shipment to various destinations. 
 
• You do a quality check and you sort and label the sample for the right department/shipment address. 
 
• You scan and print barcodes and prepare the sample for check-out. 
 
• You communicate issues and keep a clean work space. 
 
• You work in a safe and timely manner.
 

Your profile:

 

 
• You like routine and precise work. 
 
• You have good spoken and written understanding of English. 
 
• You can follow strict procedures. 
 
• You can follow a certain work rhythm and have no issue with KPI's. 
 
• You have a sense of responsibility because you handle important samples. 
 
• You can work easily with a computer. 
 
• You are open to work on Saturdays and bank holidays. 
 
• You can work in rotating shifts: Mon-Fri (8am -4pm) / Tue-Sat (8am -4pm). They shift every three weeks.

Our client is a high-tech company and a spin-off of KU Leuven, operating as one of Europe's largest research centers and tackling a wide range of technological challenges. Innovation is at the heart of everything they do.

Would you like to be at the forefront of developments in artificial intelligence, nanotechnology, and ICT? Then don't hesitate to apply. This could be your opportunity to contribute to the technologies of tomorrow and help shape the future.

Jobomschrijving

Our client, an internationally renowned research organization based in Leuven and recognized worldwide as a pioneer in nanoelectronics and digital technology, is looking for a Line Coordinator Helpdesk.

Are you analytical, detail-oriented, and passionate about keeping processes running smoothly? Then this Line Coordinator Helpdesk opportunity might be the perfect fit for you.

Your responsibilities:

• Check submitted information for accuracy and completeness.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and analytical professional who enjoys working accurately and taking responsibility.

About the Opportunity

We are looking for a Mendix Low-Code Expert to join a major international IT project within a European institutional environment in Brussels.

You will be responsible for designing, developing and maintaining secure, scalable and accessible business applications using Mendix. Working within an Agile and multidisciplinary environment, you will collaborate with business analysts, UX/UI specialists, testers and project teams to transform business requirements into robust digital solutions.

The role also involves enterprise integrations, application security, reusable components, testing, deployment and production support.

Your Role:

As a Mendix Low-Code Expert, you will:

• Translate business requirements and user stories into robust Mendix applications.
• Design domain models, workflows, user interfaces and application security roles.
• Develop integrations with internal and external systems using REST APIs, database connectors and enterprise authentication mechanisms.
• Work with authentication technologies such as SAML and OIDC.
• Develop reusable Mendix modules, widgets and components.
• Contribute to shared development standards and best practices.
• Apply secure-by-design principles, role-based access control and data-protection requirements.
• Develop accessible interfaces in line with WCAG 2.1 AA standards.
• Write unit and automated tests and participate in code reviews.
• Monitor application quality and contribute to the management of technical debt.
• Support deployments, release management and third-level production support.
• Produce and maintain technical documentation.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of Mendix development practices. 
The Profile We Are Looking For:

We are looking for a highly experienced Mendix Developer / Low-Code Expert with a strong software-development background and proven experience delivering enterprise applications.

You should have:

• At least 5 years of IT development experience.
• At least 3 years of hands-on Mendix development experience.
• Mendix Advanced Developer certification or higher.
• Experience delivering at least two Mendix applications into production.
• Practical experience with Mendix 10 or later.
• Experience integrating Mendix applications with enterprise systems.
• Experience with on-premises and/or private-cloud environments.
• Working knowledge of Java and JavaScript, particularly for custom Mendix actions, widgets or extensions.
• Experience working in Scrum or another Agile development framework.
• Strong understanding of application security, testing, integration, maintainability and software-development best practices.
• English at C1 level.
Key Skills:

• Mendix 10+
• Low-Code Application Development
• Domain Modelling
• Microflows / Application Workflows
• REST APIs & Enterprise Integrations
• SAML / OIDC
• Role-Based Access Control
• Java
• JavaScript
• Application Security
• Testing & Quality Assurance
• Production Support
• Agile / Scrum
• Technical Documentation
• WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility
Desired Qualifications:

The following would be considered strong advantages:

• Mendix Expert Developer certification.
• Experience working within a European institution, public administration or other large-scale public-sector environment.
• Experience with Mendix AI capabilities, including GenAI connectors or Maia.
• Experience leading or contributing to complex enterprise Mendix implementations.
• Experience developing reusable Mendix components and shared application libraries. 
Additional Information

• Location: Brussels, Belgium
• Working regime: Full-time
• Environment: International and multicultural
• Language: English C1 required; French is considered an advantage
• Work arrangement: Brussels-based; specific on-site/teleworking arrangements will be communicated during the recruitment process.
What We Offer:

Joining Alsena means contributing to high-impact international IT projects within a complex and multicultural environment.

You will have the opportunity to work on large-scale digital solutions, strengthen your expertise in Mendix, low-code development, enterprise integrations, application security and cloud environments, and contribute to modern applications used in a demanding institutional context.

You will work alongside experienced technical professionals while gaining exposure to complex enterprise systems and modern software-development practices.

You lead and coach a team of approximately 15 employees within the manual packaging department.

You organise the daily activities and ensure that operations run smoothly and efficiently.

Zij zijn een innovatieve en groeiende speler in de verse voedingssector, waar kwaliteit, duurzaamheid en teamwork centraal staan. In een dynamische omgeving krijg je de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, verantwoordelijkheid op te nemen en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Samen bouwen ze elke dag aan sterke resultaten én een succesvolle toekomst.

Jobomschrijving

As a Production Shift Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily operations of a modern packaging and production department. You lead a team of approximately 150 employees across multiple packaging lines and ensure that production targets, quality standards and customer requirements are achieved efficiently and safely.

You are a visible leader on the shop floor, coaching and supporting your team while continuously looking for opportunities to improve processes, efficiency and performance.

What will you do?
	
• Lead and support a large operational team, including direct supervision of team leaders.	
• Monitor production planning, quality, safety and productivity targets.	
• Coordinate closely with planning, logistics and maintenance teams to ensure smooth daily operations.	
• Follow up on employee performance, coaching and development.	
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and operational efficiencies.	
• Ensure products meet the highest quality standards and customer expectations.

Who are you?
	
• You have experience in a supervisory role within a production, packaging or food manufacturing environment.	
• You are a strong people manager who can motivate, coach and develop teams.	
• You remain calm under pressure and can effectively prioritize in a dynamic environment.	
• You have an interest in production processes and a willingness to develop your technical knowledge.	
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English; knowledge of Romanian is an asset.	
• You are quality-focused, hands-on and solution-oriented.	
• You understand the flexibility required in a fresh food environment where quality and customer service are key.

What you will do
 

You will be a member of the Defect Inspection Engineer team (DIE) which is part of the Inspection and Metrology Characterization group (IMC). The IMC group is responsible for the metrology and defectivity process portfolio and tools and follows up processes under evaluation/validation for furture needs. As process engineer in the DIE team, you will be responsible for tools and processes:
 
 

• Process & tool qualification, monitor stability, implement improvements for improved quality and cycle time. 

• Troubleshooting defectivity related issues reported by the First Line Support which cannot be resolved by themselves. 

• Analyze data utilizing sound statistical methods and present summaries to peers and management. 

• Fulfill requests for new applications and create the tool recipes. 

• Investigate tool and recipe issues, focus on root cause analysis and development of long-term solutions. 

• Utilizing expert interpersonal skills, collaborate in a dynamic multidisciplinary and multicultural environment in close cooperation with researchers, hardware engineers, operations, industry assignees, device and process experts. 

• As opportunities arise, innovate new techniques of characterization that align with the Imec’s technology roadmap. 

• You will work in two shifts (early/late) including one weekend out of four (Sa/Su), to support the 24h by 7d fab. 

Who you are
 
 

• You obtained a Master in Science or Engineering or equal by experience and display strong engineering skills and mindset. 

• Experience in a FAB environment is a strong asset. 

• You are data driven and seek out information before making decisions and taking action. 

• You like to work autonomously, well organized, with good attention to detail and set high standards for quality. 

• You speak fluent English. 

• As you will work in cross functional teams, strong communication and reporting skills are required. You are a team player with strong drive to share your expertise and knowledge with colleagues. You strive to document and report.
